title: Keep the core story and original motion logic from an official 3D reference…
content: Keep the core story and original motion logic from an official 3D reference, but rebuild the camera path, pacing, and cinematic treatment to create a completely different interpretation and narrative tone.
tips: Keep the core story and original motion logic from an official 3D reference, but rebuild the camera path, pacing, and cinematic treatment to create a completely different interpretation and narrative tone.

es.content: Mantén la historia central y la lógica de movimiento original de una referencia 3D oficial, pero reconstruye el recorrido de la cámara, el ritmo y el tratamiento cinematográfico para crear una interpretación y un tono narrativo completamente diferentes.

fr.content: Conservez l’histoire centrale et la logique de mouvement originale d’une référence 3D officielle, mais reconstruisez le trajet de la caméra, le rythme et le traitement cinématographique afin de créer une interprétation et un ton narratif complètement différents.

ja.content: 公式の3Dリファレンスにあるコアのストーリーと元のモーションロジックは維持しつつ、カメラの軌道、テンポ、cinematicな演出を再構築して、まったく異なる解釈と物語のトーンを生み出す。

ko.content: 공식 3D 레퍼런스의 핵심 스토리와 원래의 모션 로직은 유지하되, 카메라 경로, 페이싱, 그리고 cinematic 연출은 새롭게 재구성하여 완전히 다른 해석과 서사적 톤을 만들어낸다.

pt.content: Mantenha a história central e a lógica original de movimento de uma referência 3D oficial, mas reconstrua o caminho da câmera, o ritmo e o tratamento cinematográfico para criar uma interpretação e um tom narrativo completamente diferentes.

zh.content: 保留官方 3D 参考中的核心故事和原始运动逻辑，但重新构建镜头路径、节奏和 cinematic 处理，以创造出完全不同的诠释和叙事基调。
